headline: I kill people, frame someone, and let you work out what happened | Plot Twist Games & Cinderella Events
about:
I kill people for a living. Fictionally.

Two businesses. Same obsession.

Plot Twist Games is the consumer side. Murder mystery and social deduction games you play on your phone. Think The Traitors, but in your living room. Or AI suspects you interrogate who actually respond to your questions, lie to your face, and remember what you already asked. No app. No downloads. From £19.99.

Cinderella Events is the corporate side. Virtual murder mysteries for teams. Professional actors play the suspects live on camera over Zoom. Your team investigates together. Nobody has to act, read a script, or wear a silly hat. And the cynics who didn’t want to come are usually the ones who enjoy it most!

Same philosophy behind both: give people a genuine challenge and get out of the way. 

www.plottwistgames.com | www.cinderella-events.com

updates.postText:
Last night we ran a murder mystery for 64 people from all over the place. 

It was going brilliantly. Actors were performing, people were really getting into to it, accusations were already flying. Exactly what we built it to do.

Then our database provider went down. Unannounced maintenance following a drone strike in the Middle East caused cascading failures across their infrastructure. Middle of the event. No warning.

The platform that runs the evidence, the voting, the team chat. Gone.

So we improvised. Brought everyone back into the main room. Got theories in the chat. Ran the final sequence live with the actors doing their closing statements to the whole group.

It worked. Different to what we planned, but it worked.

Couple of things I took from it.

You can build the best platform in the world and still be at the mercy of something completely outside your control. A drone strike 3,000 miles away took out a murder mystery in someone's living room in Yorkshire. 

And the event still landed. Because the core of what we do is actors and a good story. The tech makes it better. But take it away and you've still got 64 people who want to know who did it.

The bigger picture is that for us, it disrupted a game. For people living through those strikes, it's their lives and their safety. Bit of perspective. 

Massive thanks to The HoLT and Lea 🌈 Turner for trusting us with what ultimately a very fun evening!

about:
I'm Ashley, a data and analytics leader passionate about helping organizations turn data into a strategic advantage. Over the last decade, I’ve built and led high-performing analytics teams, developed omni-channel attribution models, created analytics strategies, and implemented scalable data and analytics ecosystems for eCommerce, digital products, and marketing teams. 

My work has helped businesses optimize conversion, accelerate experimentation, and unlock revenue through better decision-making by having trustworthy data. I believe my best skill set is my ability to bring both the technical acumen and knowledge while always having the bigger picture in mind. I focus on tying my client's business objectives and goals into the day to day analytics/data work so they don't have to worry about how they'll be able to measure progress towards those goals. I take complex technical language and distill it into what leaders want most, how this work impacts the business. 

My goal is to make data and analytics more accessible and understandable to everyone regardless of technical knowledge. Empowering leaders and product owners to make decisions quickly and credibly is an important part of my work. 

Separate from client work I am able to sell and identify areas for opportunities within existing clients, which led to me to generate $900k in sales in my time at Valtech. I can handle every aspect of the process from selling the work in to delivering the technical aspects. This helps me better understand the entire process from taking a clients goals down to what actions we need to measure to track those goals. 

I have a passion for analytics and data and love helping companies get to that next level. I've recently enjoyed working with non-profits and animal welfare organizations as the work is extremely impactful and meaningful. However, I have worked with organizations of all sizes and across all industries, specializing in larger and enterprise type projects at Valtech and Innocean. 

I've also been on the start-up side of things and have enjoyed helping them reach their potential and growth goals. 

Outside of analytics I'm a massive animal lover and my passion for rescue dogs is what led me to volunteer at a local shelter and eventually start working with non-profits. My two rescue pitbulls are my inspiration for being a proud vegan, and I believe that my love of animals motivates me to make a positive impact on the world.

updates.postText:
Today is the day - wish me luck. 😳😳

Walt Disney EMEA Security Team have travelled people from all over the world to be at their annual 2 day event. 

For all of today (for their sins) they’re trapped in a room with me as I share some of my fave content on leadership communication. ❤️❤️

Whoop! 

#waltdisney #excited #communication #selfdevelopment #coach

Ok - here comes another Angie rant ……If you get p*ssed off because I won’t work with you for free - then that’s on you - not me. 

Am I driven by money?

Nope. 

Do I value my time and my energy resources?

Hell yes! 

I try my hardest to provide (free) value in my content. 

I regularly get emails saying how something I have said or done has helped someone. 

And that’s ace. It fills me with joy. 

I also get emails where I CAN help someone quickly - and if that’s the case - I always WILL. 

So always feel free to ask - and in that very moment if I can help I will - if I can’t I won’t. 

But questions like: 

👉 Angie how do I beat imposter syndrome? 
👉 Angie how do I become more confident? 
👉 Angie - I hate my job and don’t know what to do next - what should I do?

Sadly, each answer would require a deep dive….. not a couple of paragraphs. 

So I reply something like  “sorry you’re having a hard time at the moment. Sadly I simply can’t answer your question quickly as it’d require a deep dive. If this is something you’re interested in knowing more about please let me know”. 

Following that - if you then feel inclined to suggest: 

🛑 Clearly it’s all about the money for me 
🛑 That I’m uncaring 
🛑 That you expected more help from me because of my posts 
🛑 blah blah blah 

….then let me be clear - attempting to shame me for not giving you what you want doesn’t budge my needle. 

However, the irony of this situation is what I’m demonstrating is boundaries. 

I’m also answering with honesty about what I am, or am not able to offer in that very moment. 

So many problems that people have, stem from a lack of honesty and shortage of boundaries. 

So if nothing more take heed of my actions - and learn from those rather than being pis*ed I won’t spend hours working with you for free. 💡💡💥 

Finally, I appreciate you can’t hear my verbal intended tone in this post. 

It could be read like I’m being sh*tty. 

To be clear - I don’t feel sh*tty - but I did feel the need to express my firm opinion on this matter.

Rant over. 

Thanks for reading. 

The end 🙏

#selfrespect #boundaries #honesty #selfdevelopment #coach

headline: 📷 Hate the camera? I’ve got you! Photography and visibility strategy with marketing baked in to help you show up with confidence
jobTitle: Photographer & Visibility Marketing Strategist | Creator of awesome images 📷
about:
Does being on camera make you squirm, but you know you need to show up to grow your business? 

With my super-friendly and natural approach, I help you feel comfortable and confident on camera, whether you're a quietly ambtious solopreneur or a small corporate team (some of whom are dreading headshot day).

I offer brand photography and visibility strategy, combining creativity and marketing know-how to make showing up and connecting with clients simple.

I work with:
📷 founders and small businesses who are reluctant but ready to build a personal brand
📷 small teams who need headshot photography or brand imagery done efficiently yet creatively
📷 product businesses needing high-quality imagery with an independent approach

The boring but reassuring bit: I've run my photography business since 2010 and I'm fully qualified as a Craftsman of the Guild of Professional Photographers. I co-authored the #1 bestselling business book 'Be Brand Rich: Elevate Your Brand, Business & Your Visibility' and I've had images published in British Vogue, Hello! magazine, as well as on household-name packaging. I've also had photography go viral worldwide twice - so you can be confident I know how to create high-quality attention-grabbing visuals.

Being visible is critical to growing your business, but if that fills you with dread, I'll put you at ease so it doesn't feel awkward or stressful. Creating vibrant, authentic and storytelling imagery makes my heart sing, and it will make your marketing easier, attracting more of the clients you love.

Wondering where to start? Download my free guide to why visibility matters or DM me to chat about how a shoot can help boost your business.

experiences.title: Photographer & Visibility Marketing Strategist | Creator of awesome images 📷
experiences.jobDescription:
At Photography by Abi Moore, I specialise in creating vibrant and storytelling imagery that makes your marketing easier and more effective.

From brand photography to make social media marketing easy for solopreneurs to headshots to help your website shine to product photography that aligns perfectly with your brand.

With a considered approach, I perfectly tailor your photography to achieve your marketing goals.

My superpower is helping everyone feel comfortable in front of the camera, so your images feel authentic and confident, helping you easily connect with your dream clients.

I am skilled with both natural light and studio lighting, and can advise on the best options to suit your project, along with guidance on location, styling and posing.

My client images have been published in Vogue, Hello! and national and interanational news for client PR. I know how to create an attention grabbing-image and have had two photography projects go viral globally.

During the time running my own business, I have been awarded Craftsman with the Guild of Professional Photographers, as well as creating consistently award-winning images to gain the Guild of Photographers' Bar.

experiences.title: International PR & Internal Comms Manager
experiences.jobDescription:
After completing a general management graduate scheme, I became an Internal Communications Manager and later International PR Manager, working across internal comms and marketing for international departments, in my last role accountable for all internal and media communications for British Airways in the Middle East, Asia and Australasia.

Developed and implemented internal and external communications strategies and plans. Advised managers across the region on communications strategies; briefing up to CEO level. Assessed media opportunities and briefed journalists. Managed a team of 4 and a network of PR agencies across 20 countries.

Notable experience in issues and crisis management, including managing BA’s response in Asia to the emergency landing of the BA38 in January 2008 and the opening of Terminal 5 in March 2008.
